# Finisher brief

Continue the assigned task from its handoff and existing branch/worktree. Read AGENTS.md, the handoff, and any task packet. Inspect committed and uncommitted state before making changes.

You are not alone in the codebase. Preserve other owners' edits. Complete remaining acceptance checks, resolve integration issues, and fold durable notes into the project docs. Retire the handoff when complete and clean up owned processes/worktrees according to the integration policy. Do not spawn nested agents.
